events.summary: FAA certification of the largest 737 MAX variant clears it for delivery weeks after a software-related certification delay, unlocking a key single-aisle model in Boeing's contest with Airbus just ahead of Q3 earnings.
events.headline: U.S. FAA certifies Boeing 737-10, largest member of 737 MAX family

events.summary: A seven-year defense award to speed production of PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement seekers deepens Boeing's high-demand missile-defense backlog.
events.headline: Boeing receives seven-year contract to accelerate PAC-3 MSE seeker output

events.summary: A widebody freighter order from Ethiopian Airlines adds to Boeing's 777 freighter backlog, supporting the widebody production ramp.
events.headline: Ethiopian Airlines Orders Boeing 777 and 777-8 Freighters to Expand Cargo Fleet

events.summary: Boeing won a multi-billion-dollar U.S. Navy contract to design, build and deliver the F/A-XX sixth-generation carrier fighter to replace the F/A-18 Super Hornet — its second sixth-generation fighter selection after the Air Force's F-47 award in 2025.
events.headline: U.S. Navy Selects Boeing for F/A-XX Program

events.summary: The FAA said it will hold off certifying the 737 MAX 10 until a newly disclosed software issue (which could block pilots' access to automated flight guidance in a specific landing scenario) is resolved; Boeing shares closed down 6.9% on the news. Certification was widely expected in October and was subsequently granted on October 20, 2026.
events.headline: U.S. federal aviation regulator delays Boeing 737 Max 10 certification, shares dive 7%

events.summary: Finalization of an order for up to 150 737 MAX jets from Turkish Airlines — one of Boeing's largest single-aisle commitments, materially bolstering the 737 backlog.
events.headline: Boeing and Turkish Airlines Finalize Order for up to 150 737 MAX Jets

events.summary: Biman ordered five 787-10 and six 737-8 jets, bringing its 787/737 MAX order book with Boeing to 25 jets, following its earlier 14-jet order this year.
events.headline: Biman Bangladesh Airlines Orders 11 More Boeing Jets to Expand Fleet
